scripts.android:debug: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
